svg.text: GRADIENTS AND TOP-HATS READ HEIGHTS; SOBEL READS SLOPES
160 on both sides of the step
160 in the gap the closing filled
the gradient is a range, max − min over the cross: 160 is the step's height and 215 the impulse's, never cancelled
Sobel reads 640 = 4 × 160 on the step and 0 on the impulse itself, where its two halves cancel
each panel is shaded on its own scale; the numbers are the values
